But{NEWLINE}I forgot to give it to you! Wahaha!{SCROLL}Don’t worry, it’s not too late. You’re{NEWLINE}sure to find it useful, so please come{CLEAR}and pick it up yourself!{SCROLL}Come to my Lab in Pallet Town!

Simply perfect!{SCROLL}The world of Pokémon and the Trainers{NEWLINE}around them will grow wider,{CLEAR}deeper and richer!{SCROLL}And that is exactly why our research{NEWLINE}into Pokémon will never stop!
